scientific_intent.application_domain: Bioinformatics / banded affine-gap sequence alignment extension
scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Seeded local sequence score extension with asymmetric affine gaps, adaptive band and zdrop early termination
scientific_intent.numerical_method: Serial integer dynamic programming dependency DAG; source gaps open from M rather than full H, rightmost row ties and strictglobalimprovement; Float32 bandclamp
scientific_intent.community_use: Alignment extension primitive in sequence analysis; no CIGAR, whole-genome mapping, biological identification or sensitivity/specificity experiment
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact all6outputstatistics and fullH/E/queryprofile scratch; 17shipped goldenrecords independently match Pythonrow-snapshot recurrence plus5synthetic controls, allreadonly/guards exact
limitations: Source extension policy is narrower than arbitrary textbook SmithWaterman, not a different objective substitute
Serialone-thread kernel, no parallelwavefront/genome-scale throughput claim

shared_observed_usage_windows.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Marker-turn alignment is approximate; not exclusive source translation or monetary billing. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, not extra totals. No historical recovery. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.
shared_observed_usage_windows.counter_span_interpretation: Observed counter difference; alignment and interleaving prevent exclusive billed-cost claims. Zero/no-new-event spans cannot imply zero translation effort.
